images.after: Start with posture, because it's free
images.title: Free posture check before you buy
images.alt: Posture checklist for screen, elbows, wrists, feet and back, based on OSHA and Mayo Clinic guidance on a neutral sitting position.
images.caption: Whatever you can't achieve with your current furniture becomes your shopping list.

items: Screen top at or slightly below eye level, about an arm's length away
Elbows close to your body, bent between 90 and 120 degrees
Wrists straight and in line with your forearms
Feet flat on the floor, or on a footrest
Lower back supported, upright or leaning back slightly

images.note: No posture is good for hours on end. Adjust, stretch and stand up regularly

images.title: Two ways to raise a laptop screen
images.alt: Comparison of two screen-height fixes: a laptop stand with an external keyboard and mouse, or an external monitor on a stand or arm.
images.caption: Raising the laptop without a separate keyboard trades a neck problem for a wrist problem.
